price_selection: Maximize baseline exploratory mean operating profit; tie chooses lower price. Freeze quote regardless; recommend launch only if exploratory mean is positive. Confirmation cannot change the price.
primary_attribution: E = U = identical-content ordinary library in offer, costs, participation, capacity and outcomes. No measured operational alpha is assumed.
compensation_note: May 2025 national median employee wages; provisional physical-scientist domain proxy. June 2026 professional/scientific/technical total-compensation-to-wage ratio supports rounded 1.46 proxy. Overhead is an explicit assumption, not included in wage statistics.
compute_note: Hypothetical capped text/source assistance workload. Exact rational solver runs locally. Reasoning output is included in output-token allowance; retries must fit allowance or be added. No API calls were made by this model.
source_cost_note: Assumed digital-source access/export cost; not an established archival tariff. Rights, unavailable originals, and expert admissibility construction remain explicit unresolved inputs.
customer_value_note: Assumed opportunity cost, not a consultant quote, willingness-to-pay observation or human development cost. Decisive-outcome value is independently drawn.
payment_note: Scenario assumptions: 3% of collected value plus $0.30 collection attempt, including a $0.30 failed balance attempt; $0.30 refund transfer. Pending expected balance fees and definite refusal-refund fees accrue at the decision; original collection fees are not returned. No provider tariff is claimed.
reserve_policy: All unaccepted deposits remain restricted; full collected fees remain reserved through refund window; accrued unpaid costs and remaining completion budget are reserved. Debt is deducted again only when calculating free funds, not when determining payment liquidity.
assumptions_note: All demand, probability, duration, labor-effort, overhead, capacity, payment and value parameters are scenario assumptions. No mission probability is calibrated from finite possible-world test counts.
acquisition_cost_note: Explicit assumed cash-channel cost per originating opportunity, separate from intake labor; $0/$15/$50 sensitivity cases. No acquisition cost was measured.
attempt_budget_note: Hard cap: listed role labor plus at most one listed rework round and one extra capped compute workload. Budget exhaustion causes refusal/refund and no fee; all incurred work remains A. Completion/admissibility probabilities are assumptions conditional on these caps, not synthetic technical pass rates.
outside_success_rule: q_H = source admissibility × original-query decisiveness × acceptance; q_offer = q_H × (1−provider budget-exhaustion probability). Provider-specific budget failure never reduces human outside-option reliability.
